# Baripas Studio

> Baripas Studio is an independent single-player mobile game studio based in Türkiye. It publishes small, focused games with no feeds and no social noise: Cube Pattern (3D cube memory puzzle), Swipe Clone (path-copying game) and Angle Dare (precision angle game).

Baripas Studio builds calm, single-player mobile games for iOS, iPadOS and Android. The studio's flagship title is **Cube Pattern**, a free 3D spatial-memory puzzle. Contact: contact@baripas.studio.

## Games

- [Cube Pattern](https://baripas.github.io/cube-pattern.html): Free 3D cube memory game for iPhone, iPad and Android. Memorize a glowing tile pattern on a rotating cube, then rebuild it. 100 levels, daily challenge, 4 game modes, offline play, 6 languages. Published by Baripas Studio. App Store id 6825930492; Google Play package com.barip.cubepattern.
- [Cube Pattern (Türkçe)](https://baripas.github.io/cube-pattern-tr.html): 3D küp hafıza oyunu. Ücretsiz; 100 bölüm, günlük meydan okuma, çevrimdışı oynanış, altı dil.
- [Swipe Clone](https://baripas.github.io/#swipe-clone): Watch a generated path, then copy its shape and pace with one finger. Three-part scoring and a visible pace profile.
- [Angle Dare](https://baripas.github.io/#angle-dare): A precision angle game. The target angle is shown briefly; the live measurement stays hidden until you lock in.

## Key facts about Cube Pattern

- Genre: 3D spatial memory puzzle / brain training game.
- Platforms: iOS 16+ (iPhone, iPad), Android 8.0+.
- Price model: free to download; optional premium subscription (monthly/yearly), one-time lifetime unlock, cosmetic collections, hint packs and coin packs. Rewarded ads are optional.
- Content: 100 story levels in 10 chapters, three-round Master Cube finale, daily challenge (UTC), Memory Climb, 60s Blitz, Zen modes.
- Modes and systems: boosters, memory profile with 8 skill dimensions, achievements, weekly leaderboard, friends, ghost challenges, live events, cosmetics and mascots.
- Offline: story levels and modes work without an internet connection. Sign-in is optional and only needed for sync, leaderboards and social features.
- Languages: English, Turkish, German, Spanish, French, Portuguese.
- Developer: Baripas Studio, Türkiye.
